title: 1991 Ultra #171 Darryl Strawberry Los Angeles Dodgers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a vintage 1991 Ultra sports trading card featuring Darryl Strawberry of the Los Angeles Dodgers. The card measures 4" x 3" and is an original, not a licensed reprint. It is part of the Ultra set by Topps and is signed by NS, but not autographed. 

The card is in great shape and is perfect for collectors of baseball memorabilia. It is a must-have for fans of the Los Angeles Dodgers or Darryl Strawberry. Don't miss out on the chance to own a piece of baseball history.
